memories.content: The president is responsible for deciding whether the pier viewing party goes ahead. They are aware of the eclipse schedule and need to consider weather forecasts, equipment availability, and any logistical issues. They have not yet made a decision as of the simulation start.

A partial solar eclipse is scheduled over Marlin Bay on the 12th. The astronomy club typically holds a pier viewing party for such events. The president is expected to confirm by the 10th whether the party is going ahead. Weather forecasts and other conditions may influence the decision.
